Create a ui-spec document.

Usage: papyrus ui-spec create [OPTIONS] <TITLE>

Arguments:
  <TITLE>  UI specification title

Options:
      --json                       Emit stable, machine-readable JSON.
      --view <VIEW>                View
      --description <DESCRIPTION>  Description Use "-" to read multiline text from standard input.
      --dir <path>                 Project directory. Default: the current working directory.
      --config <file>              Configuration file. Default: papyrus.config.yml in the project directory.
      --label <LABEL>              Label
      --no-color                   Disable ANSI color output.
      --reference <REFERENCE>      Reference
  -h, --help                       Print help
